'''Star Tours Flight 815''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. The day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight was set to arrive at the spaceport's Gate 1C at 1325. It was scheduled to depart again at 1420.
